gaps.sentence: We had the whole house ___ (repaint) before the wedding.
gaps.explanation: 'Had the house repainted' — painters did it at our request. Object + past participle.

gaps.sentence: She's having her wedding dress ___ by a tailor in Naples.
gaps.explanation: Have + object + past participle: having her dress made by a professional.

gaps.sentence: The winners ___ (notify) by email at the end of the week.
gaps.explanation: Future simple passive: will be + notified for the plural subject 'the winners'.

gaps.sentence: The escaped prisoner ___ (believe) to be hiding in the mountains.
gaps.explanation: Impersonal passive pattern: subject + is believed/said/reported + to-infinitive.

gaps.sentence: Guests ___ to arrive no later than seven.
gaps.explanation: Guests receive the request: present simple passive are + asked.

gaps.sentence: The finalists ___ (interview) live on air as we speak.
gaps.explanation: 'As we speak' demands the present continuous passive: are being + interviewed.
Negative present simple passive: are not + past participle (given).

gaps.sentence: This wall ___ (build) centuries ago — no modern tool leaves marks like these.
gaps.explanation: Perfect modal passive: must have been + built to draw a conclusion about the past.
